privacy.intro: How we collect, use and protect your information.
privacy.s1.p: Name, email, phone, blood group, district, upazila, address, date of birth, optional photo and optional identity document, plus donation and request records you enter.
privacy.s2.p: Only if you agree: your name, blood group, district, upazila, availability, donation count and verified status. Your full address is never public.
privacy.s3.p: Shown to signed-in users only if you allow it, or to a requester when you respond to their request.
privacy.s4.p: Stored in a private location outside the website, visible only to administrators, and every view is logged.
privacy.s5.p: To run the donor directory, notify matching donors of emergency requests, send reminders and prevent abuse. We do not sell your data.
privacy.s6.p: Passwords are hashed, connections use HTTPS, access is role-based and sensitive admin actions are audit-logged.
privacy.s7.p: You can edit your profile, hide yourself from the directory, withdraw consent and permanently delete your account and data at any time from your dashboard.
terms.intro: By using this platform you agree to the following.
terms.s1.p: This platform connects blood donors and people in need. It is not a medical service or a blood bank.
terms.s2.p: Timers and dates are informational. Donation eligibility must be confirmed by qualified medical staff.
terms.s3.p: You must provide truthful information. Fake emergency requests or false donation records lead to removal and suspension.
terms.s4.p: Do not ask for or offer money for blood. Report anyone who does.
terms.s5.p: Do not misuse other users' contact details, harass users or send spam.
terms.s6.p: Administrators may hide content or suspend accounts that break these terms.
terms.s7.p: These terms may be updated; continued use means you accept the update.
help.intro: Quick guides for donors and requesters.
help.s1.p: Choose Register, fill in your details and accept the terms. Your profile appears in the directory only if you consent.
help.s2.p: Use Find donors and filter by blood group, district, upazila and availability.
help.s3.p: Sign in, choose Request blood and enter accurate hospital and contact details. Matching donors nearby are notified.
help.s4.p: Open a request and press "I can donate". The requester sees your name and phone and can accept your offer.
help.s5.p: In your dashboard add the donation. After administrator approval it updates your count, timer and certificate.
help.s6.p: Switch between বাংলা and English at the top of any page. Your choice is remembered.
faq.a1: Eligibility is decided by medical staff at screening. This site only shows general information.
faq.q2: How long should I wait between donations?
faq.a2: It depends on what you donate. The timer uses configurable guidance values; always follow the advice of your blood bank.
faq.a3: No. It is shown only if you allow signed-in users to see it, or to a requester when you respond.
faq.a4: Requests need an account, are rate limited, can be reported, and administrators can hide them.
faq.q5: Do I have to verify my identity?
faq.a5: No, it is optional. Verified donors get a badge and can receive verified certificates.
faq.q6: How do I get a certificate?
faq.a6: Add your donation in the dashboard. Once an administrator approves it, the certificate is available.
faq.a7: Yes. In Profile choose Delete my account; all your data is erased.
faq.q8: Is blood sold on this platform?
faq.a8: Never. Blood donation must be voluntary and free. Report anyone asking for payment.
